title: Generation of Vectorized Maps Beyond Vehicle View
abstract: arXiv:2609.07511v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous driving relies on High Definition (HD) maps for safe navigation. Traditional HD maps construction is costly in hardware, data and human resources, which together with its update limitations hinders scalability. Recent works have proposed online alternatives for HD vectorized mapping from onboard sensors. However, sensor field of view is limited, and the range of the reconstructed maps ahead of the vehicle is insufficient for safe planning. This paper aims to address this limitation by proposing the novel beyond-view vectorized map generation problem: given vectorized maps of the area sensed by the vehicle (in-view), to generate plausible map continuations. To experimentally assess its feasibility, we propose BeyondFormer, which, to the best of out knowledge, is the first work designed towards beyond-view map generation. Given the novelty of the problem, we generate the first dataset specifically designed for it and evaluate

translated_title: 超越车辆视野的矢量化地图生成
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶依赖于高精地图来实现安全导航。传统的高精地图构建方式在硬件、数据和人力资源方面成本高昂，加之其更新方面的局限性，阻碍了可扩展性。近期的研究工作提出了基于车载传感器的在线矢量化高精地图构建的替代方案。然而，传感器的视野是有限的，重建的车辆前方地图范围不足以支持安全的规划。本文旨在通过提出一种新颖的超视野矢量化地图生成问题来解决这一局限性：给定车辆感知区域（视野内）的矢量化地图，生成合理的地图延续部分。为了通过实验评估其可行性，我们提出了BeyondFormer，据我们所知，这是首个面向超视野地图生成设计的工作。鉴于该问题的新颖性，我们生成了首个专门为此设计的数据集并进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了超视野矢量化地图生成这一新问题，并首次提出BeyondFormer模型，能够基于车辆视野内的矢量化地图生成视野之外合理的地图延续，同时构建了首个专门针对该任务的数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the novel problem of beyond-view vectorized map generation and proposes BeyondFormer, the first model capable of generating plausible map continuations beyond the vehicle's sensor field of view, along with the first dataset specifically designed for this task.
